title: Asking after Red Happy Bolton
summary: They talk about a friend's address and Rene advises him to stop smoking.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues

blocks.x: This is who that Paul Bob Red Show looks tough there.
Big gut, he's all wrinkly. I got to go see that. He still lived down on those, um, New Orleans streets yet?
No, I think he lives at 2605 St. Anthony.

2605 St. Anthony. Yeah. You know Punch-Pama looking good now? Oh yeah, Punch-It's alright. I told him, see, you better put that cigar on out, don't you start the food around there. Start to go back to smoking, because that nigga T ain't good for his system yet.
